title: Golden Skeleton Creator
description: A towering golden skeleton with glowing red eyes stands over a mound of colorful paint, dripping vibrant liquid from its hands onto a white humanoid figure reaching upward. The barren, cracked landscape features ancient monoliths under a swirling, apocalyptic sky filled with ghostly faces and hands.
prompt: A giant golden skeleton with glowing red eyes and melting colorful paint dripping from its fingers stands over a mound of vibrant liquid paint, reaching down toward a small white humanoid figure who reaches up from the base of the mound. The cracked purple wasteland ground contains scattered fossils and ancient weathered monoliths. The dramatic sky is filled with swirling dark clouds and ghostly spectral faces and hands. Surreal dark fantasy scene, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
